title: 第八章 应劫第九章 截运术
content_zh:
第八章【应劫】
陈言面色凝重。
自己自从学会了这个《气运周数》后，新鲜感强着呢，恨不能一天给自己算八遍。
要不是所有奇术都会消耗一点元气的话，可能还会更多。
自己记得真真切切，自己昨晚算过这次旅途运道，那是平安无事，一路顺遂才对。
怎么上了飞机后，就……
那就是，这飞机上，有人妨我！
陈言想到这一条，立刻深吸了口气，搬运元气灌注到双目，然后眯着眼睛，以天眼望气之法朝着四周看去。
这一看……
【我擦，这片黑气哪儿来的？！
就看见机舱里，四周头等舱的所有客人，不分男女老少，每个人的脑袋上都有一些细微的若有若无的黑气缭绕。
就连空姐也不例外。
而这一丝黑气漂来，方向却居然是来自于后面的经济舱。
陈言心中跳了跳，立刻从座位上起身，往经济舱里走过去。
一路走下来，经济舱里也是一样的情况，每个旅客的脑袋上，都被缠绕上几丝丝细微的黑气，而一丝丝黑气，最后聚拢一起，却都是从一个方向流淌而来。
陈言一路走到了经济舱的最后面一排座位，然后站在了那儿。
这趟飞机没有坐满，经济舱最后一排座位上，左边一排，只有最里面靠窗的位置坐了一个人。
看着瘦瘦小小的一只，一件宽大的棉服外套，垂着头，脑袋上套着兜帽，整个人缩在靠窗的座位里，缩成一团，看起来似乎也是睡着了的样子。
陈言用望气术看去，只见这人头顶，那一团黑气缭绕，厚厚实实如乌云压顶！
不但厚，而且好像还在酝酿，越聚越多……

找到根儿了！
这人，简直就差身上贴个标签了：霉运当头！
陈言站在那儿掐指算了算，以这种程度的黑气，那才是货真价实的血光之灾！
而且这黑气还在一点点的聚集着，按照这个趋势下去，这人的霉运，怕是要连带这趟航班的所有人了！
看着黑云压顶的运道，这个劫怕是不小！
陈言瞬间就后背出了汗。
脑子里快速的思索着册子记载的各种转运之法……
倒是看过好些个，但都级别不低，不是自己这种刚入门的小菜鸟可以施展出来的。
况且，手里也没法器啊。
焦急中倒是灵机一动，想起一个不是办法的办法来。
只不过，治标不治本罢了。
在册子里写过的一种【破劫】的法子。
气运这个东西，不论正负，都是慢慢堆积的。
负面的气运堆积到一定程度，就会形成所谓的【劫】。
而要想破除大劫，除了正经八百的那些成本比较高的转运法术之外，还有一种法治标不治本的法子：
提前应劫。
说起来复杂，其实很容易理解：就比如说你的霉运正在累积，一旦累积到顶，憋个大的，会让你有一个大的血光之灾。
轻则重伤，重则嘎掉那种。
但，如果你在这个【血光之灾】累积成型之前，先来了个大姨妈……
这不就先见血了么。

那血光之灾，就算是【应劫】了。
就像蓄水池，蓄满之前，你先给它凿了一个窟窿，那么水就泄掉，而且势头会减弱许多，蓄满的时间就会大大推迟很久……
想到这里，陈言叹了口气，无奈的看了看周围，然后攥着拳头，附身靠近了对方。
这一走近了，才看清楚对方居然是个妹子，看着脸嫩的很。
content_en:
Chapter 8 [Response to the Tribulation]
Chen Yan looked solemn.
Ever since I learned this "Qi Luck Week Number", I feel so fresh that I wish I could count it for myself eight times a day.
Maybe more if not all thaumaturgy consumes a bit of vitality.
I remember very clearly that I calculated my luck for this trip last night, and it was safe and smooth.
Why did after getting on the plane...
That is, someone is disturbing me on this plane!
When Chen Yan thought of this, he immediately took a deep breath, poured vitality into his eyes, then squinted his eyes and looked around using the method of looking at the air with the heavenly eye.
This look...
[Hey, where did this black air come from? !
I saw that in the cabin, all the first-class passengers around, regardless of gender, old or young, had some subtle black air lingering on their heads.
Even the flight attendants are no exception.
But this trace of black air came from the economy class at the back.
Chen Yan's heart skipped a beat, and he immediately stood up from his seat and walked to the economy class.
Along the way, the situation was the same in the economy class. Each passenger's head was entangled with a few tiny black airs, and the black air finally gathered together, but they all flowed from one direction.
Chen Yan walked all the way to the last row of seats in the economy class and stood there.
This flight was not full. In the last row of seats in the economy class, on the left row, there was only one person sitting in the innermost seat by the window.
Looking at the thin and small one, wearing a large cotton coat, with his head hanging down and a hood on his head, he was huddled in the window seat, huddled up, and he seemed to be asleep.
Chen Yan used his Qi-gazing technique to look around and saw a mass of black energy hovering above the man's head, as thick as a dark cloud!
Not only is it thick, but it also seems to be brewing, gathering more and more...
Found the root!
This man just needs a label on his body: bad luck!
Chen Yan stood there and counted with his fingers. With this level of black energy, it was a real bloody disaster!
Moreover, this black energy is still gathering little by little. If this trend continues, this person's bad luck may affect everyone on this flight!
Looking at the fate of the dark clouds, this disaster is probably not small!
Chen Yan's back immediately broke out in sweat.
My mind was quickly thinking about the various transshipment methods recorded in the booklet...
I have seen quite a few of them, but they are all of a high level and cannot be used by a newbie like me.
Besides, I don’t have a magical weapon in my hand.
In my anxiety, I suddenly had an idea and thought of a solution that was not a solution.
It's just that it's just treating the symptoms rather than the root cause.
A method of [breaking the tribulation] written in the booklet.
Luck, whether positive or negative, accumulates slowly.
When negative luck accumulates to a certain extent, it will form the so-called [tribulation].
In order to get rid of the catastrophe, in addition to the more expensive transshipment spells, there is also a method that treats the symptoms but not the root cause:
Respond to disaster in advance.
It sounds complicated, but it is actually easy to understand: for example, your bad luck is accumulating. Once it reaches the top, if you hold it back for a long time, you will have a big bloody disaster.
It can range from serious injuries to severe injuries.
But, if you have an aunt before this [bloody disaster] accumulates and takes shape...
Isn't this the first time I see blood?
That bloody disaster can be regarded as a [catastrophe].
Just like a reservoir, before it is full, you dig a hole in it, then the water will drain out, and the momentum will weaken a lot, and the time to fill it will be greatly delayed for a long time...
Thinking of this, Chen Yan sighed, looked around helplessly, then clenched his fists and approached the other party.
Now that I got closer, I saw clearly that the other person was actually a girl, and her face looked very tender.
